evidence: newDirectory loops on Mkdir returning fs.ErrExist and takes the next numbered suffix. Any other error returns immediately, so a missing parent or a file at .vault-meta still fails fast, and the loop ends once a free name is found.

BackUp removes the directory with RemoveAll only when copyInto fails, and only the directory that newDirectory just created, so no earlier backup is touched. A RemoveAll failure is joined into the returned error rather than lost.

copyInto keeps the original behaviour, with only the return signature changed. The diff has no import hunk, so I could not check that errors, fmt and io/fs are imported. The tests exercising the new code suggest the package compiles.

The tests cover two backups at one instant, a failed copy leaving no directory with a successful retry, and a byte-for-byte restore. The edit to AFailedBackupWritesNothing keeps the failure path covered by making .vault-meta a file.
